name: zinterp_context_run_string
description: zInterp_Context::RunString executes lines from a script stream until input ends or parsing stops.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
RunString participates in the recursive zInterp execution loop with RunStream, HandleBuiltinCommand, and RunScriptFile, so dependency acceptance is made for the group rather than as an isolated leaf.
Binary Ninja/frontier output may show a stale x87/int80 artifact for the RunStream call, but both function contracts are eax-only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4c1020 validates null stream handling, hasPreparedInput/currentScriptFile setup, line buffer clearing, ReadLineOrPreparedTokens plus RunStream loop condition, and hasPreparedInput reset before returning success.
Native smokes cover RunString through RunScriptFile nested-source execution and RunStream builtin execution.
